title: I draw comics.
intro: Milton Aguiar. Portuguese comic book artist: pencils, inks and colours. Creator of Raptor, co-founder of ImaginAction Comics.

story.title: The artist
story.text: I am a comic book artist from Portugal. I pencil, ink and colour: covers, interior pages, pin-ups and commissions. A page starts in pencil on the board and stays there until it works.

story.title: Why comics
story.text: Batman. He is the character that made me want to draw comics, the reason I made a hero of my own, and a reminder not to back down when I know I should not. One day I hope to draw him for real.

story.title: Raptor
story.text: That hero is Raptor, my own vigilante, and the book I am drawing now. The Preamble was funded by its readers on Indiegogo and is out on GlobalComix; the Prelude is next.

story.title: ImaginAction
story.text: I co-founded ImaginAction Comics to publish creator-owned books, Raptor first. I also draw covers and colours for other people's comics, and animate a little on the side.
